gaps.explanation: Detail revenue = General Fund departments schedule only (pp10-11, total 218,173). The Street Fund has its expenditure line in detail (Public works 92,907 from the p9 budget schedule) but none of its revenue: p5 governmental funds statement, Street Fund column prints Motor vehicle tax 6,621 + Franchise 5,947 + Intergovernmental 94,623 + Sale of equipment 1,562 + Miscellaneous income 1,864 = Total revenues 110,617. 218,173 + 110,617 = 328,790 = statement total (p5 Total Governmental Funds).

gaps.explanation: Detail has the business-type expenditure lines (Water 101,337, Sewer 15,219, Solid Waste 55,320 from the p9 budget schedule, = statement 171,876) but no business-type revenue: the p9 schedule's 'Other local receipts' 333,788 mixes governmental and utility receipts, so it was not recorded. The p7 proprietary statement prints the revenue per fund: Water Fund Sales 139,133 + Miscellaneous income 1,800 + Interest income 2,605 = 143,538; Sewer Fund Sales 31,792 + Interest income 400 = 32,192; Solid Waste Fund Sales 56,521 + Miscellaneous income 598 = 57,119. Sum 232,849 = statement total (operating revenues 229,844 + interest 3,005). 0 + 232,849 = 232,849.
